column1: SELECTED_DECISION=Compound-block statement routing: given a parsed statement, decide whether it is APPENDED to the block statement list or SKIPPED because it is a global-variable declaration
SELECTED_INPUT_1=stmt->kind  (the AstKind enum value of the parsed statement)
SELECTED_INPUT_2=stmt->declvar->kind  (the AstKind enum value of the statement declvar)
SELECTED_OUTPUT=one bounded boolean: 1 = APPEND the statement to the block statement list, 0 = SKIP it

SELECTED_DISTINCTNESS_REASON=The decision reads TWO bounded AstKind values and answers a compound-block APPEND/SKIP question.  It shares NO decision with BootstrapSwitchArmTerminates (a one-value arm-termination test), with BootstrapCalcPadding (an alignment computation), with BootstrapValidPostControlFlowToken (a token-validity test), with BootstrapOperatorPrecedence (a precedence lookup), with BootstrapAstBinOpFromToken or with BootstrapAstUnaryOpFromToken (token-to-operator classifications).
